description: This file contains implementation of POSIX socket helper functions for testing, including socket creation, connection, buffer size configuration, and local address retrieval, within the 'starboard::nplb' namespace.

methods.name: PosixSocketCreateAndConnect
methods.description: Creates, binds, listens, and connects sockets for testing, with timeout handling.

methods.name: PosixSocketSetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size for a socket.

methods.name: PosixSocketSetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size for a socket.

methods.name: PosixGetLocalAddressIPv4
methods.description: Retrieves the local IPv4 address of the machine.

methods.name: PosixGetLocalAddressIPv6
methods.description: Retrieves the local IPv6 address of the machine (if supported).
